title: The Loud Little Parrot: Learning Your Inside Voice!

lines.text: Polly the colorful parrot loved exercising her vocal cords at maximum volume!
lines.caps: Polly the colorful parrot loved exercising her vocal cords at *MAXIMUM | *VOLUME!

lines.text: She flew into the cozy public library and squawked, HELLO EVERYONE, LOOK AT MY FEATHERS!
lines.caps: She flew into the cozy public library and squawked, HELLO EVERYONE, *LOOK | AT MY *FEATHERS!

lines.text: Ears hurt, books rattled, and sleeping baby squirrels woke up crying in fright!
lines.caps: Ears hurt, books rattled, and sleeping baby squirrels woke up crying in *FRIGHT!

lines.text: Librarian Owl held up a gentle wing and explained the difference between voice spaces!
lines.caps: Librarian Owl held up a gentle wing and explained the difference between *VOICE | *SPACES!

lines.text: The wide open playground is for booming cheering, shouting goals, and loud laughter!
lines.caps: The wide open playground is for booming cheering, shouting goals, and *LOUD | *LAUGHTER!

lines.text: Inside cozy rooms, gentle voices protect people's focus and create peaceful spaces!
lines.caps: Inside cozy rooms, gentle voices protect people's focus and create *PEACEFUL | *SPACES!

lines.text: Polly leaned in and practiced her warm, gentle whisper voice: Want to read together?
lines.caps: Polly leaned in and practiced her warm, gentle whisper *VOICE: | Want to read *TOGETHER?

lines.text: Knowing when to be quiet and when to be loud shows respect for everyone around you!
lines.caps: Knowing when to be quiet and when to be loud shows respect for *EVERYONE | around *YOU!

lines.text: Use your gentle voice and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
